method: Prices were read live on 2026-10-05 from maker/importer sites where they rendered as static text (Honda UK honda.co.uk, Kawasaki UK's own pricing-announcement article, Suzuki GB bikes.suzuki.co.uk, CFMoto UK cfmoto.co.uk, Triumph UK triumphmotorcycles.co.uk model pages, KTM Ireland ktm.com/en-ie model page, Royal Enfield/Benelli/Aprilia/Moto Guzzi/Voge/Keeway/SYM/Lambretta/Moto Morini/QJMOTOR/ItalJet/Hanway/Royal Alloy/KTM/Husqvarna/Indian catalogue pages on the UK importer platform motogb.co.uk and its sister site mmcbikes.co.uk, Zontes dealer mattwilliamsonmotorcycles.co.uk, Maeving dealer englishelectricmotorco.com, Lexmoto lexmoto.com, Sinnis sinnismotorcycles.com, AJS ajsmotorcycles.co.uk, Mash dealer dmamotors.co.uk, Kymco kymco.co.uk, and Megabikes Ireland megabikes.ie for Honda/Yamaha/Vespa Ireland pricing). Where a maker's own site would not render as fetchable text (BMW, Yamaha UK, Ducati, Vespa UK, MV Agusta, Zero, Norton, BSA, Energica), the figures were read instead from the UK new-bike aggregator bikesinstock.co.uk (dealer-listed RRP/OTR, filtered to new stock) or another named UK dealer site, each recorded as sourceType secondary with the exact URL read. No figure was estimated or carried over from general knowledge; cc is recorded only where the source page itself showed a displacement figure, otherwise left null. Economy, tank, battery kWh and kerb weight were not systematically collected in this pass (time-boxed research) and are null unless a source happened to state one.
